insert into uso_tokens (execution_id, conversacion_id, etapa_id, modelo, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, creado_en)
select '{{ $json.execution_id }}','{{ $json.conversacion_id }}'::uuid, nullif('{{ $json.etapa_id }}','')::uuid, '{{ $json.modelo }}', {{ $json.prompt_tokens }}, {{ $json.completion_tokens }}, coalesce(nullif('{{ $json.creado_en }}','')::timestamptz, now())
where exists (select 1 from conversaciones where id='{{ $json.conversacion_id }}'::uuid)
on conflict (execution_id) do nothing;
